examples.new: SELECT cell_lac_tac, cell_ci, COUNT(*) AS n FROM response_records WHERE imsi='260000000000009' AND cell_ci IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cell_lac_tac, cell_ci ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1;
